subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who gives help and sympathy to people who need it.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Samaritan **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samaritan **is a noun that refers to a person who helps and sympathizes with those in need. (एक व्यक्ति जो जरूरतमंद लोगों की मदद करता है और उनके प्रति सहानुभूति रखता है)
 
• It is derived from the biblical story of the Good Samaritan who helped a stranger in need.
 
• The term is often used to describe someone who performs acts of kindness and charity.
 
 
• **For example**: *The Samaritan stopped to help the injured man on the side of the road.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Preacher **refers to someone who delivers religious sermons or teachings. (कोई व्यक्ति जो धार्मिक उपदेश या शिक्षा देता हो)
 
• **Moralist **refers to someone who is concerned with the principles of right and wrong behaviour. (कोई व्यक्ति जो सही और गलत व्यवहार के सिद्धांतों से चिंतित है)
 
• **Pardoner **refers to someone who grants forgiveness or absolution. (कोई व्यक्ति जो क्षमा या दोषमुक्ति प्रदान करता है)
